current_status_detail: Reported full resolution is verified as a primary-source claim. Complete mathematical proof validity has not been independently checked in this packet. Do not label the target currently open on the September ranking alone.
exact_poincare_target: There is a universal C<infinity such that, for every n>=1 and every isotropic log-concave probability measure mu on R^n, Var_mu(f)<=C integral |grad f|^2 dmu for all locally Lipschitz f in L^2(mu) with finite Dirichlet energy. Isotropy means mean 0 and Cov=I_n; extended convex potentials and convex supports are included.
cheeger_normalization: h_mu = inf_A mu^+(A)/min(mu(A),1-mu(A)), with Euclidean outer Minkowski boundary measure; require h_mu >= universal c > 0. In Klartag's notation h_mu = 1/psi_mu. Do not reverse the direction for psi_mu.

primary_formulation.author: Bo'az Klartag
primary_formulation.verified_content: Definition C_P uses squared gradient. Relation 1/4 <= psi_mu^2/C_P <= pi makes the formulations equivalent. The 2023 theorem gives psi_n <= C sqrt(log n), hence a Poincare upper bound of order log n; it is not dimension-free.
